title: PREINCARNATION enemy presentation
sourceGap: No approved enemy-definition file and no renderer contract were mounted in the project. This book does not invent combat numbers, AI, or boss state machines. Boxes are alpha guides.

canon.whyUnnamed: The assignment speaks of forty ordinary enemies and sixteen bosses, but no name list was in the project files. Inventing the other names would fake a roster.

contract.damageWindow: timing.attack only, and only when the preview is set to connect
contract.falseCueRule: Impact, splash, stone-break, and projectiles do not play during anticipation. Ground marks are labeled TELL.

vfxPolicy.impact: On connect, at the muzzle, during the attack frame only. One shot. Not on a whiff. Not during the tell.
vfxPolicy.dust: Low, behind the feet, on movement. Never in front of a telegraph shape.
vfxPolicy.shadow: Under the feet anchor. Static if reduced motion is on.
vfxPolicy.projectiles: Gallery only for this batch. None of these sixteen attacks are ranged in the approved sense — no definition said they shoot — so bolts are not autoplayed.
vfxPolicy.status: Gallery samples. Not bound to invented status mechanics. Shapes differ without color.
vfxPolicy.ground-tells: Arrow, ridge, ring, fissure. They play in the anticipate window and are not damage.

actors.name: Rubble Mite
actors.tell: The top plate lifts, so the stack gets taller before it slams.
actors.notes: Melee slam. No chip projectile — a second flying sprite would read as a different attack.

actors.name: The Sentinel
actors.silhouette: Tall tripod and hood, then a low wedge
actors.tell: Before the dash the hood closes to a slit, the tripod folds into a wedge aimed along the dash, and a gravel arrow scratches the ground. The gold collar is only an extra glint.
actors.notes: Gold is not sufficient. Grayscale still shows slit, wedge, and arrow. Dash art is drawn facing east. West is a mirror. North and south dash frames are not drawn.

actors.name: Lake Memory
actors.silhouette: Faceless ripple with a blank oval head
actors.tell: A second silhouette peels up out of the feet and one ring spreads. No strobe.
actors.notes: Late boss. Not a portrait of a person. The peel is the cue. The reach is the strike.
